race.comment: CERTIFIED COPY (1) strips rock-hard fit and isn't doing much wrong. Loves this trip, but just needs to carry the weight. Up to winning a race like this, as is HELLARIOUS (12) who gave backers a sight when resuming at Doomben but just lacked a fitness edge late. Better for that and so could be hard to stop this time. HERMAN SAID (10) had a genuine excuse when wide throughout here last start, and his wet-track record keeps him firmly in the winning mix. JUNGLE LAW (7) improved into second here last start, beaten just over two lengths. Won the other two times she attempted this track and trip and should be close to her peak third up.
